display.purpose: Page titles, section/card/modal headers, stat values. Never body copy.

body.purpose: Everything else: labels, table cells, form fields, running copy.

shadows.name: resting-card
shadows.purpose: Default shadow-sm on every card-like surface.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover response on interactive cards, paired with a 2px upward translate.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: The one place real depth appears; separates the modal from the page behind it.

motion.name: ease-out-strong
motion.purpose: Default easing for all interactive transitions: button press, hover, modal enter, progress bar fill.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button (submit forms, confirm actions).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #49111c; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #49111c; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #0a0908; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e5dacd; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f2f4f3; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action button (delete event, delete locality).
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: transparent; color: #8c2430; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #8c2430; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgba(140,36,48,0.1); } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field (buyer name, cédula, teléfono, amounts).
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #ffffff; color: #0a0908; border: 1px solid #e5dacd; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #49111c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #49111c; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill showing sale state: disponible, separado, or vendido.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge--disponible { background: rgba(122,104,82,0.15); color: #7a6852; } .ds-badge--separado { background: rgba(140,90,46,0.2); color: #8c5a2e; } .ds-badge--vendido { background: rgba(92,42,68,0.15); color: #5c2a44; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Event/locality card: title, meta rows, action buttons.
components.html:
Concierto de Verano

Teatro Metropolitano

15 de agosto, 2026
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5dacd; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #0a0908; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-meta { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #5e503f; margin: 0; } .ds-card-meta--muted { color: #7a6852; }

components.name: Nav Tab
components.description: Section tab in the event sub-header (Dashboard / Localidades).
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-tab { padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #5e503f; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-tab:hover { background: #f2f4f3; } .ds-nav-tab--active { background: #49111c; color: #ffffff; }

narrative.overview:
Valhalla Eventos runs box-office operations for live-music events: staff selling palcos and boletas simultaneously, tracking partial payments, watching a shared ledger update in real time. The visual system is an opulent, wine-dark account book — precise numbers dressed in gothic romance, never the other way around. This is Operate mode, not marketing: the gothic-romantic identity lives in restrained, deliberate details (one wine-red accent, a display typeface reserved for structure, a palette that never uses pure black or pure gray), while the actual working surface — tables, grids, forms, running totals — stays scannable, flat, and fast under sales-window pressure.

The system explicitly rejects two failure modes: the generic SaaS admin dashboard (purple-to-blue gradients, cards nested in cards, Inter-everywhere sameness) and nightlife-cliché neon (anything loud, glowing, or discotheque-coded). What's left is closer to a ledger bound in leather than a screen full of widgets: dark ink, warm earth neutrals, hairline rules instead of heavy chrome, and exactly one accent color doing all the pointing.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color (wine #49111c) carries every interactive and brand cue; nothing else competes with it.
Flat surfaces at rest, hairline borders instead of shadow as the default separator.
A single earthy palette family does double duty as UI neutrals, chart series, and status colors — nothing is a one-off.
Display type (Space Grotesk) marks structure only: page titles, card/modal headers, stat values. Everything else reads in Plus Jakarta Sans.
Full light/dark theming via CSS custom properties, with the same roles and relationships preserved in both.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Wine appears only where the interface wants a click or wants to say "this is the brand" — never as a large fill, never decoratively. Its rarity is what makes it read as intentional.

rules.name: The No Pure Black Rule
rules.body: Ink and every dark surface carry a warm brown undertone, never #000000 or a cool gray. Flatness comes from restraint, not from defaulting to grayscale.

rules.name: The Typeface-Switch Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is expressed by switching from body to display type, not by scaling body type up. A "big number" is always set in Space Grotesk at 700, never Plus Jakarta Sans at a larger size.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadow only appears as a response to state (hover) or to establish real z-order (modal). A card that isn't hovered or floating has no shadow beyond the barely-there resting value.

dos: Do keep Wine as the only accent used for interactive/brand cues. If a second UI color is needed, pull from the existing status/data palette rather than introducing a new hue.
Do default new surfaces to flat + hairline border; add shadow-sm only if the surface is genuinely card-like, shadow-md/lift only as a hover response.
Do set structural moments (page titles, section headers, stat values) in Space Grotesk; everything else in Plus Jakarta Sans.
Do use the --ease-out-strong curve and 150-300ms durations for interactive feedback (button press, hover, modal enter).
Do keep Spanish domain vocabulary in UI copy (palco, boleta, localidad, abono, comprador) — this is a durable product/brand commitment, not just a language choice.
donts: Don't introduce pure black (#000000) or a cool/neutral gray anywhere — every dark value in this system carries a warm brown undertone.
Don't reach for a second accent color, a gradient, or neon/glow treatments — they read as off-brand for a gothic-romance ledger, not just "bold."
Don't stack cards inside cards, or add shadow to a surface that isn't hovered or floating (modal). Depth here is earned, not decorative.
